WITH RECURSIVE model_bom AS (
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty,
        comp.is_assembly,
        comp.unit_cost
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = c.child_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        c.child_code AS component_code,
        c.qty * mb.qty AS qty,
        comp.is_assembly,
        comp.unit_cost
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = c.child_code
    JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.component_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'component'
      AND mb.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(qty * unit_cost), 2) AS total_parts_cost
FROM model_bom
WHERE is_assembly = FALSE;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- Direct SKUs mapping to the model
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT child_code AS sku_code
    FROM u_composition

  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Start with the model and its direct component children
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND c.parent_code = 'NO3-140WAL14-0111'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty AS qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) AS valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END AS valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c 
        ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind

    WHERE e.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'

WITH uk_completed_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS order_qty,
        l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024
),
sku_model_mapping AS (
    SELECT 
        ue.root_code AS sku_code,
        ue.item_code AS model_code,
        ue.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_explosion ue
    WHERE ue.root_kind = 'sku'
      AND ue.item_kind = 'model'
      AND ue.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
bundle_contents AS (
    SELECT 
        ue.root_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        ue.item_code AS item_sku_code,
        ue.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM u_explosion ue
    WHERE ue.root_kind = 'sku'
      AND ue.item_kind = 'sku'
      AND ue.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
expanded_orders AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: direct model mapping
    SELECT 
        smm.model_code,
        uco.order_qty * smm.model_qty_per_sku AS model_units
    FROM uk_completed_orders uco
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON uco.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model_mapping smm ON ss.sku_code = smm.sku_code
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = FALSE
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand to item SKUs, then to models
    SELECT 
        smm.model_code,
        uco.order_qty * bc.item_qty_per_bundle * smm.model_qty_per_sku AS model_units
    FROM uk_completed_orders uco
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON uco.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_contents bc ON ss.sku_code = bc.bundle_sku_code
    JOIN sku_model_mapping smm ON bc.item_sku_code = smm.sku_code
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = TRUE
)
SELECT 
    cm.model_code
FROM expanded_orders eo
JOIN company_model cm ON eo.model_code = cm.model_code
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(eo.model_units) DESC
LIMIT 3;

    JOIN u_composition c ON c.parent_kind = me.child_kind AND c.parent_code = me.child_code
    WHERE me.child_kind = 'component'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
      -- Ensure the overlapping interval is valid
      AND GREATEST(me.valid_from, c.valid_from) <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (CASE 
            WHEN me.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN me.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(me.valid_to, c.valid_to)
          END IS NULL OR 
          CASE 
            WHEN me.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN me.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(me.valid_to, c.valid_to)
          END >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all parts (non-assembly components) with their total quantities
parts_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        me.child_code as component_code,
        SUM(me.qty) as total_qty
    FROM model_explosion me
    JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = me.child_code
    WHERE me.child_kind = 'component'
      AND comp.is_assembly = false
      AND me.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (me.valid_to IS NULL OR me.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    GROUP BY me.child_code
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(ps.total_qty * comp.unit_cost), 2) as total_parts_cost
FROM parts_summary ps
JOIN component comp ON comp.component_code = ps.component_code;

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the bundle SKU
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as total_qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-UK-0139'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode assemblies and follow model/component links
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        (be.total_qty * c.qty)::DOUBLE as total_qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition c ON 
        -- From SKU to model (non-bundle SKUs)
        (be.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = be.child_code)
        OR
        -- From model to component
        (be.child_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = be.child_code)
        OR
        -- From assembly component to sub-component
        (be.child_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = be.child_code)
    WHERE c.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
      -- Only continue if current node is an assembly (for component->component) or is sku/model
      AND (
          be.child_kind != 'component' 
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM component comp WHERE comp.component_code = be.child_code AND comp.is_assembly = true)
      )
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0) as total_units
FROM bom_explosion be
JOIN component comp ON be.child_code = comp.component_code AND be.child_kind = 'component'
WHERE comp.component_code = 'FAS-956-BLK-01640'
  AND comp.is_assembly = false;

    -- Base case: direct children of the bundle SKU
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-CA-0316'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode children
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        e.qty * c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON e.child_kind = c.parent_kind AND e.child_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the bundle SKU
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-DE-0328'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        b.qty * c.qty::DOUBLE as qty
    FROM bom_explosion b
    JOIN u_composition c ON 
        -- If current item is a sku, explode to its models
        (b.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
        OR
        -- If current item is a model, explode to its components
        (b.child_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
        OR
        -- If current item is an assembly component, explode to its sub-components
        (b.child_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = b.child_code)
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

          b.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model')

WITH RECURSIVE model_components AS (
    -- Start from all company models
    SELECT 
        cm.model_code,
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM company_model cm
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'model' AND uc.parent_code = cm.model_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recurse through sub-assemblies
    SELECT 
        mc.model_code,
        c.component_code AS child_code,
        mc.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM model_components mc
    JOIN component parent ON parent.component_code = mc.child_code AND parent.is_assembly = true
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' AND uc.parent_code = mc.child_code
    JOIN component c ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_code) AS model_count
FROM model_components
WHERE child_code = 'MOT-367-WHT-00971';

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of the bundle SKU
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        c.qty::DOUBLE as qty,
        c.valid_from,
        c.valid_to
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.parent_code = 'BDL-CA-0123'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: explode assemblies and follow SKU->model and model->component edges
    SELECT 
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        (e.qty * c.qty)::DOUBLE as qty,
        GREATEST(e.valid_from, c.valid_from) as valid_from,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.valid_to IS NULL THEN c.valid_to
            WHEN c.valid_to IS NULL THEN e.valid_to
            ELSE LEAST(e.valid_to, c.valid_to)
        END as valid_to
    FROM bom_explosion e
    JOIN u_composition c ON (
        -- Follow edges based on current node type
        (e.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_code = e.child_code)
        OR 
        (e.child_kind = 'sku' AND c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = (
            SELECT m.model_code FROM company_model m
            JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = e.child_code
            -- Need to find model mapping through u_composition
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM u_composition mc 
                WHERE mc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND mc.parent_code = e.child_code
                AND mc.child_kind = 'model' AND mc.child_code = m.model_code
            )
            LIMIT 1
        ))
        OR
        (e.child_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_kind = 'model' AND c.parent_code = e.child_code)
        OR
        (e.child_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_kind = 'component' AND c.parent_code = e.child_code)

      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

          WHERE comp.component_code = e.child_code AND comp.is_assembly = true
      ))

WITH RECURSIVE bom_explosion AS (
    -- Base case: direct children of components that are assemblies
    SELECT 
        c.component_code AS root_code,
        c.component_code AS item_code,
        1.0 AS qty
    FROM component c
    WHERE c.is_assembly = true
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive step: follow composition edges
    SELECT 
        be.root_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_code,
        be.qty * uc.qty AS qty
    FROM bom_explosion be
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON uc.parent_kind = 'component' 
        AND uc.parent_code = be.item_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Get all components that contain FOO-311-OAK-00402 at any level
components_with_foo AS (
    -- Direct containment
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS component_code
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'component'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
        AND uc.child_code = 'FOO-311-OAK-00402'
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
    
    UNION
    
    -- Indirect containment through assemblies
    SELECT 
        be.root_code AS component_code
    FROM bom_explosion be
    WHERE be.item_code = 'FOO-311-OAK-00402'
),
-- Add the component itself if it's FOO-311-OAK-00402 (though we need models containing it, not itself)
all_containing_components AS (
    SELECT component_code FROM components_with_foo
),
-- Find models that map to these components (directly or through composition)
models_from_components AS (
    -- Direct model -> component
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS model_code
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
        AND uc.child_code IN (SELECT component_code FROM all_containing_components)
        AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
),
-- Also need to consider: models map to components, but we need to check if FOO-311-OAK-00402 is in the explosion

        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.item_code = 'FOO-311-OAK-00402'
        AND ue.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_code) AS model_count
FROM models_via_explosion

      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'

direct_sku_model AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        uc.qty as model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                         AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
                         AND uc.child_code = 'NO7-180WAL49-0340'
                         AND uc.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
                         AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false

        ss_parent.sku_id as bundle_sku_id,

    WHERE ss_parent.is_bundle = true
),

        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku ss ON l.sku_id = ss.sku_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- For non-bundle SKUs, get model mapping using u_composition
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode to child SKUs then get their models

-- Direct model mappings from SKUs (non-bundle)
direct_model_map AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = false
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Bundle to item SKU mappings
bundle_items AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        ss.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM sales_sku ss
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
        AND uc.parent_code = ss.sku_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE ss.is_bundle = true
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Item SKUs to models
item_model_map AS (
    SELECT 
        uc.parent_code AS sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM u_composition uc
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
),

-- Calculate total model units sold
-- Case 1: Direct SKU -> model sales
direct_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        osq.order_line_qty * dmm.model_qty_per_sku AS model_units
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN direct_model_map dmm ON osq.sku_id = dmm.sku_id
    WHERE dmm.model_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
),

-- Case 2: Bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model sales
bundle_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        osq.order_line_qty * bi.item_qty_per_bundle * imm.model_qty_per_sku AS model_units
    FROM order_sku_qty osq
    JOIN bundle_items bi ON osq.sku_id = bi.bundle_sku_id
    JOIN item_model_map imm ON bi.item_sku_code = imm.sku_code
    WHERE imm.model_code = 'ER6-120GRY30-0515'
)

SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(model_units) FROM direct_sales), 0
) + COALESCE(
    (SELECT SUM(model_units) FROM bundle_sales), 0
) AS total_model_units_sold

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, find all SKUs that map directly or indirectly to model SW4-120BLK46-0337
-- Direct mapping: non-bundle SKU -> model
-- Indirect: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model

-- Step 1: Get the model_id for the target model
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id, model_code
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'SW4-120BLK46-0337'
),

-- Step 2: Find all SKUs that directly map to this model (non-bundle SKUs)
direct_skus AS (
    SELECT s.sku_id, s.sku_code, s.is_bundle, 1.0 AS model_qty
    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = s.sku_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'model' AND uc.child_code = (SELECT model_code FROM target_model)
    WHERE s.is_bundle = FALSE
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 3: Find all bundle SKUs and their item SKUs that eventually map to the target model
-- We need to explode bundles to find which item SKUs map to our model
bundle_items AS (
    -- Base: direct composition from bundle to item SKU
    SELECT 
        b.sku_id AS bundle_sku_id,
        b.sku_code AS bundle_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty AS item_qty_per_bundle
    FROM sales_sku b
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc.parent_code = b.sku_code
                         AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE b.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
),

-- Step 4: Find which bundle items map to our target model
bundle_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        bi.bundle_sku_id,
        bi.bundle_sku_code,
        bi.item_qty_per_bundle * COALESCE(uc2.qty, 1) AS total_model_qty_per_bundle
    FROM bundle_items bi
    LEFT JOIN u_composition uc2 ON uc2.parent_kind = 'sku' AND uc2.parent_code = bi.item_sku_code
                               AND uc2.child_kind = 'model' AND uc2.child_code = (SELECT model_code FROM target_model)
                               AND uc2.valid_from <= '2024-12-31' AND (uc2.valid_to IS NULL OR uc2.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')
    WHERE uc2.qty IS NOT NULL  -- only keep items that map to target model
),

-- Step 5: Aggregate bundle contributions (one bundle might have multiple items mapping to same model)
bundle_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        bundle_sku_id AS sku_id,
        bundle_sku_code AS sku_code,
        TRUE AS is_bundle,
        SUM(total_model_qty_per_bundle) AS model_qty
    FROM bundle_to_model
    GROUP BY bundle_sku_id, bundle_sku_code
),

-- Step 6: Union all SKUs that contribute to this model
all_contributing_skus AS (
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, is_bundle, model_qty FROM direct_skus
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sku_id, sku_code, is_bundle, model_qty FROM bundle_skus
),

-- Step 7: Get all order lines for these SKUs in 2024 with completed orders
order_lines_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.qty,
        acs.model_qty,
        ol.qty * acs.model_qty AS model_units_sold
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN all_contributing_skus acs ON l.sku_id = acs.sku_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(model_units_sold), 0)::BIGINT AS total_model_units_sold
FROM order_lines_2024

      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2024-01-01')

                         AND c2.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                         AND c2.child_kind = 'model'
                         AND c2.child_code = 'ER3-140OAK94-0094'
    WHERE c1.parent_kind = 'sku'

      AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31'

)

        0
    ) +

        (SELECT SUM(bundle_units_sold * multiplier) FROM bundle_sales),

    ) AS total_model_units_sold

        osl.sku_id AS current_id,
        -- Root of explosion
        'sku' AS root_kind,
        osl.sku_code AS root_code,

        CAST(osl.line_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_qty,
        0 AS level
    FROM order_sku_lines osl
    
    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        e.order_id,
        e.line_qty,
        e.order_date,
        -- New current becomes the child
        uc.child_kind AS current_kind,
        uc.child_code AS current_code,
        NULL::INT AS current_id,
        e.root_kind,
        e.root_code,
        -- Multiply quantity
        e.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty,
        e.level + 1
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc 
        ON e.current_kind = uc.parent_kind 
       AND e.current_code = uc.parent_code
    WHERE e.order_date >= uc.valid_from
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR e.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
      -- Only follow sku->sku (bundle), sku->model, model->component, component->component
      AND (
          (e.current_kind = 'sku' AND uc.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model'))
          OR (e.current_kind = 'model' AND uc.child_kind = 'component')
          OR (e.current_kind = 'component' AND uc.child_kind = 'component')
      )
)
-- Sum up all paths that end at our target part

FROM exploded e

        ol.order_line_qty * buc.qty AS order_line_qty,
        ol.order_date,
        buc.child_code AS sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_per_sku_qty
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN u_composition buc ON buc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND buc.parent_code = ol.sku_code
        AND buc.child_kind = 'sku'
        AND buc.valid_from <= ol.order_date
        AND (buc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= buc.valid_to)
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
        AND uc.parent_code = buc.child_code
        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
        AND uc.valid_from <= ol.order_date
        AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR ol.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
    WHERE ol.is_bundle = true
),
-- Now explode models to all components (including parts) using u_explosion
model_to_components AS (

        sm.order_date,
        sm.sku_code,
        sm.model_code,
        sm.model_per_sku_qty,
        ue.item_code AS component_code,
        ue.qty AS component_per_model_qty
    FROM sku_to_model sm
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.root_code = sm.model_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'
        AND ue.valid_from <= sm.order_date
        AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR sm.order_date <= ue.valid_to)

    FROM model_to_components

        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        uc.qty::DOUBLE AS sku_multiplier

        es.root_sku_code,
        es.item_sku_code,
        es.sku_multiplier,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty::DOUBLE AS model_qty
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_code = es.item_sku_code

    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),

-- We need to explode bundles to get the underlying SKUs

        ss.sku_code,
        ss.is_bundle

    SELECT

        ol.line_qty * uc.qty AS sku_qty,
        ss_child.sku_code,

    FROM order_lines ol

    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'

      AND ol.order_date >= uc.valid_from

        AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    JOIN company_model cm ON uc.child_code = cm.model_code
    WHERE se.is_bundle = false
      AND se.order_date >= uc.valid_from

    FROM sku_to_model stm

        AND ue.item_kind = 'component'

    SELECT

    FROM sales_sku s
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ue.root_code = s.sku_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'model'

        ue2.item_code AS model_code,
        ue1.qty * ue2.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM sales_sku s
    -- First explode bundle to get item SKUs
    JOIN u_explosion ue1 ON ue1.root_kind = 'sku' 
        AND ue1.root_code = s.sku_code
        AND ue1.item_kind = 'sku'  -- item SKU inside bundle
    -- Then explode each item SKU to get its models
    JOIN u_explosion ue2 ON ue2.root_kind = 'sku'
        AND ue2.root_code = ue1.item_code
        AND ue2.item_kind = 'model'
    WHERE s.is_bundle = true

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Get SKU quantities sold (sku_id -> qty)

    SELECT l.sku_id, SUM(jo.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM jp_orders jo
    JOIN listing l ON jo.listing_id = l.listing_id
    GROUP BY l.sku_id
),
-- For non-bundle SKUs, directly map to models via u_explosion
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode to child SKUs first, then those map to models
-- Let's use u_explosion from sku to find all descendant items
sku_to_models AS (
    -- Direct: non-bundle SKU -> model (via u_explosion where item_kind = 'model')
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ue.item_code AS model_code,
        ss.total_qty * ue.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON ss.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    JOIN u_explosion ue ON ue.root_kind = 'sku' AND ue.root_code = sku.sku_code
        AND ue.item_kind = 'model'
        AND ue.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (ue.valid_to IS NULL OR ue.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle: bundle SKU -> item SKU -> model
    -- First get child SKUs from bundle, then map those to models
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ue2.item_code AS model_code,
        ss.total_qty * ue1.qty * ue2.qty AS model_qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON ss.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    -- Explode bundle to child SKUs
    JOIN u_explosion ue1 ON ue1.root_kind = 'sku' AND ue1.root_code = sku.sku_code
        AND ue1.item_kind = 'sku'
        AND ue1.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (ue1.valid_to IS NULL OR ue1.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

    JOIN u_explosion ue2 ON ue2.root_kind = 'sku' AND ue2.root_code = ue1.item_code
        AND ue2.item_kind = 'model'
        AND ue2.valid_from <= '2026-10-01' AND (ue2.valid_to IS NULL OR ue2.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders in JP in 2025
jp_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'JP'
      AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
),

-- Get all order lines for these orders with their SKU and quantity
order_skus AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.listing_id,
        ol.qty AS line_qty,
        l.sku_id,
        sk.sku_code,
        sk.is_bundle
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN jp_orders jo ON ol.order_id = jo.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON l.sku_id = sk.sku_id
),

-- For bundle SKUs, explode to contained item SKUs using u_composition
-- For non-bundle SKUs, keep as-is
exploded_skus AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: map directly to their models
    SELECT 
        os.line_qty,
        os.sku_code,
        os.sku_code AS item_sku_code,
        os.line_qty AS sku_multiplier,
        1 AS contained_qty
    FROM order_skus os
    WHERE os.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to child SKUs
    SELECT 
        os.line_qty,
        os.sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS item_sku_code,
        os.line_qty AS sku_multiplier,
        uc.qty AS contained_qty
    FROM order_skus os
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku' 
                          AND uc.parent_code = os.sku_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'sku'
    WHERE os.is_bundle = true
      AND uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Map item SKUs to company models
sku_to_models AS (
    SELECT 
        es.line_qty,
        es.sku_multiplier,
        es.contained_qty,
        es.item_sku_code,
        uc.child_code AS model_code,
        uc.qty AS model_qty_per_sku
    FROM exploded_skus es
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'sku'
                          AND uc.parent_code = es.item_sku_code
                          AND uc.child_kind = 'model'
    WHERE uc.valid_from <= '2026-10-01'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= '2026-10-01')
),

-- Calculate total model units: line_qty * contained_qty * model_qty_per_sku
-- For non-bundles: line_qty * 1 * model_qty_per_sku
-- For bundles: line_qty * contained_qty * model_qty_per_sku
model_units AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.model_code,
        stm.line_qty * stm.contained_qty * stm.model_qty_per_sku AS total_units
    FROM sku_to_models stm
)

SELECT cm.model_code
FROM model_units mu
JOIN company_model cm ON mu.model_code = cm.model_code
GROUP BY cm.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(mu.total_units) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH RECURSIVE
-- First, get all completed orders in CA in 2023
ca_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE s.country = 'CA'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2023-12-31'
),
-- Get all order lines with their SKU and quantity
order_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty, l.sku_id
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN ca_orders co ON ol.order_id = co.order_id
    JOIN listing l ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
),
-- Get SKU quantities sold
sku_sales AS (
    SELECT sku_id, SUM(qty) as total_qty
    FROM order_lines
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
-- For bundle SKUs, we need to explode to child SKUs
-- Get composition edges valid in 2023 (all SKU edges are always valid)
bundle_explosion AS (
    -- Direct SKU to SKU composition (bundle -> item SKU)
    SELECT 
        c.parent_code as bundle_sku_code,
        c.child_code as item_sku_code,
        c.qty as multiplier
    FROM u_composition c
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
),
-- Calculate effective SKU sales: for bundles, multiply by bundle components
effective_sku_sales AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs: direct sales
    SELECT 
        ss.sku_id,
        ss.total_qty as effective_qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    JOIN sales_sku sku ON ss.sku_id = sku.sku_id
    WHERE sku.is_bundle = false
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Bundle SKUs: explode to component SKUs
    SELECT 
        sku_child.sku_id,
        ss.total_qty * be.multiplier as effective_qty
    FROM sku_sales ss
    JOIN sales_sku sku_parent ON ss.sku_id = sku_parent.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_explosion be ON sku_parent.sku_code = be.bundle_sku_code
    JOIN sales_sku sku_child ON be.item_sku_code = sku_child.sku_code
    WHERE sku_parent.is_bundle = true
),
-- Sum effective quantities by SKU
final_sku_sales AS (
    SELECT sku_id, SUM(effective_qty) as qty
    FROM effective_sku_sales
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
-- Map SKUs to company models via u_composition (sku -> model)
sku_to_model AS (
    SELECT 
        sku.sku_id,
        c.child_code as model_code,
        c.qty as multiplier
    FROM sales_sku sku
    JOIN u_composition c ON sku.sku_code = c.parent_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= '2023-12-31'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= '2023-01-01')
),
-- Calculate model sales
model_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        stm.model_code,
        SUM(fss.qty * COALESCE(stm.multiplier, 1)) as total_model_qty
    FROM final_sku_sales fss
    JOIN sku_to_model stm ON fss.sku_id = stm.sku_id
    GROUP BY stm.model_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_sales
ORDER BY total_model_qty DESC
LIMIT 3
